mkdir .toolbox
mkdir .toolbox/tasks

cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/missing-binary.yaml .toolbox/tasks/missing.yaml
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run missing-bin
stdout 'Status: failed'
stderr 'command "toolbox-definitely-missing" not found in PATH'

rm .toolbox/tasks/missing.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/timeout.yaml .toolbox/tasks/timeout.yaml
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run timeout --timeout 100ms
stdout 'Status: failed'
stderr 'timed out after 100ms'

rm .toolbox/tasks/timeout.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/fail.yaml .toolbox/tasks/fail.yaml
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN run fail
stdout 'Exit Code: 1'
stderr 'exited with code 1'

rm .toolbox/tasks/fail.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/dup.yaml .toolbox/tasks/dup.yaml
cp $PROJECT_ROOT/testdata/scripts/manifests/dup.yaml home/.config/toolbox/tasks/dup.yaml
! exec $TOOLBOX_BIN list
stderr 'duplicate task "dup"'
